headline: Infineon lists a thesis to evaluate commercial EDA optimization tools for analog and mixed-signal design
fact: On October 6, Infineon's indexed careers listing advertised a Padua thesis/internship role to evaluate commercial EDA circuit-optimization tools for automotive analog and mixed-signal blocks. The project assesses accuracy, efficiency, engineering effort and time to finalize circuit blocks; it also describes exposure to emerging AI-driven design methodologies. The description does not name a specific optimizer, claim measured speedup, or establish production deployment. The original publication date is not established, so this Event records the observation date.

sources.title: Infineon Careers: Thesis - Optimization Tool Evaluation for Analog Design (HRC1771385)
sources.summary: Official indexed Padua student listing, checked October 6, 2026, describes commercial EDA optimization-tool evaluation and exposure to AI-driven design methods. First publication is unconfirmed; the Event date is an observation date.
